description: This file defines a CKEditor 5 plugin class 'DrupalLinkMediaUI' that manages the UI for linking media elements within a Drupal-specific CKEditor setup. It includes methods for initializing the plugin, creating a toolbar button, and handling media link selection.

classes.name: DrupalLinkMediaUI
classes.description: A CKEditor 5 plugin class that provides UI controls for linking media elements in a Drupal environment.

methods.name: requires
methods.description: Specifies required plugins: LinkEditing, LinkUI, DrupalMediaEditing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up event listeners for clicks, and creates the toolbar button.

methods.name: _createToolbarLinkMediaButton
methods.description: Creates a toolbar button 'Link media' that toggles link UI or media toolbar based on selection.

methods.name: _isSelectedLinkedMedia
methods.description: Checks if the current selection is a linked media element with a 'linkHref' attribute.
